title: U.S. House · Pennsylvania's 17th Congressional District
area: Pittsburgh's northern and western suburbs, including parts of Beaver and Allegheny counties.

context.text: Incumbent Democrat Chris Deluzio ran unopposed in the May 19, 2026 Democratic primary. Tony Guy defeated Jesse Vodvarka in the Republican primary, 53.3% to 46.7% (19,581 to 17,183 votes).

candidates.name: Chris Deluzio
candidates.ballotNote: Ran unopposed in the May 19 Democratic primary

priorities.text: Describes himself as a voting rights attorney who worked to protect voting rights and elections before running for Congress.
priorities.quote: As a lawyer, Chris worked to protect voting rights and our elections as the policy director at Pitt Cyber and previously at the Brennan Center for Justice.

positions.summary: Joined 14 other Democratic House veterans in January 2026 calling for an immediate stand down of ICE and CBP interior enforcement operations.
positions.quote: we call for an immediate stand down of ICE and CBP interior enforcement operations and demand the resignation of the Secretary of Homeland Security

positions.summary: Voted in January 2026 to extend the enhanced Affordable Care Act tax credits for three more years and said they should have been extended before expiring.
positions.quote: We should have extended the tax credits before they expired, but D.C. Republicans refused to join guys like me who were trying to stop healthcare costs from exploding.

positions.summary: Said he supports targeted tariffs against trade cheats like China but not treating close allies like Canada the same way, and called the Trump Administration's trade approach chaotic, inconsistent and incomplete.
positions.quote: And we should not treat close economic allies like Canada the same as mercantilist trade cheats like China.

record.text: Serves on the House Committee on Transportation and Infrastructure and the House Committee on Armed Services for the 2025–2026 term.

candidates.name: Tony Guy
candidates.ballotNote: Won the May 19 Republican primary, defeating Jesse Vodvarka 53.3% to 46.7%

priorities.text: Lists keeping communities safe and backing law enforcement as a campaign focus.
priorities.quote: A career law enforcement officer who will always Back the Blue and stand with our first responders.

priorities.text: Lists border security as a campaign focus.
priorities.quote: No more open borders. Fund the wall, deport criminal illegals, and stop the flow of deadly fentanyl.

priorities.text: Lists the economy and energy as a campaign focus.
priorities.quote: Pro-growth policies that empower small businesses, unleash energy dominance, and create good-paying jobs.

positions.summary: His issues page calls for funding the border wall and Border Patrol, deporting criminal immigrants and enforcing immigration laws.

statements.quote: Give cops the tools, training, and support they need to keep our streets safe.
statements.context: On his campaign website's Keeping Pennsylvania Safe section
